title: From Gravitational Action to Physical Scattering
overview: How far can an original gravitational action carry us from source-owned interactions and boundary data toward genuinely physical incoming and outgoing scattering states?
question: What additional boundary, constraint and asymptotic structures turn a source-derived kinematic scattering calculation into a physical scattering system?
foundation: In developing internal CH/P9-SA11 formal research, original-action W6 one-particle and CH24 symmetric Bose-pair states enter a common source-generated kinematic setting. Focused Lean-checked constructions establish self-adjoint free/interacting kinematic generators, strong incoming/outgoing wave isometries, equality of their ranges with the interacting absolutely continuous carrier, and a unitary kinematic comparison. A real-scaled family of the unchanged source interaction provably yields nonidentity comparisons for sufficiently small positive couplings. Separately, the complete six-sector action defines a positive complex boundary phase on its full twelve-real-control chart, while its nearby nonlinear future-frame metric fails a direct W6 fullbank readback test.
limits: The nonidentity result concerns a real-scaled kinematic interaction at source-dependent sufficiently small nonzero coupling; nonidentity at the original unit coupling remains open. The full source boundary-phase result does not give an action-derived physical W6/CH24 Hilbert carrier: the original nonlinear frame has a proved W6 range obstruction, and an inhabited source family retains nonzero released-boundary variation. Neither physical constraint/BRST preservation, a justified boundary Euler/Cartan flux law, continuum momentum covariance, a physical gravitational S-matrix, nor a celestial scattering amplitude has been constructed. This is internal formal research, not a published CH Paper IX.
next: Develop a source-derived phase space with physically justified boundary equations and Cartan flux, incorporating any necessary extra geometric degrees of freedom; prove invariant W6/CH24 Bose-pair and gauge/BRST constraints; distinguish the original unit-coupling kinematic question from physical scattering, then test on-shell channels and celestial transform eligibility.

claims.statement: For the specified original finite-rank W6⊕CH24 kinematic interaction, incoming and outgoing strong-limit wave isometries have ranges equal to the interacting absolutely continuous carrier, and their comparison is unitary.
claims.scope: Original action-linked, self-adjoint finite-rank cubic-plus-affine kinematic generators on the received two-sector Hilbert carrier and their established Cook domains. This is not a gauge/BRST-reduced physical S-matrix or celestial scattering amplitude.

claims.statement: The complete six-sector source action yields a positive compatible complex structure on its twelve-real-control boundary phase chart, but its nearby nonlinear future-frame metric cannot be identified directly with the existing W6 fullbank readback.
claims.scope: Scoped two-face interior-stationary source phase, source Cartan form and sufficiently small nonzero pure-old controls. This is a proved obstruction to that direct W6 identification, not a no-go theorem for enlarged physical carriers or other action-derived boundary conditions.

claims.statement: A real-coupling deformation of the unchanged source-owned interaction has a nonidentity kinematic scattering comparison for every sufficiently small positive coupling within a source-dependent interval, witnessed on a fixed Cook-domain state.
claims.scope: Original W6/CH24 source interaction scaled by a real coupling in a mathematically constructed kinematic family. The established radius is not certified to include unit coupling; a physical scattering operator and gravitational on-shell amplitude remain open.

claims.statement: The original cubic interaction produces a nonzero W6-to-CH24 pair response, and the corresponding source-cell one- and two-particle energy shells have checked overlapping support under the stated cell and energy conditions.
claims.scope: Source-specific kinematic one/pair channels with exact energy-domain and finite-regulator qualifications; nonzero pair creation and energy overlap do not establish a connected, spatial-momentum-covariant physical on-shell scattering amplitude.

obligations.question: Derive a physically justified boundary phase space and Euler/Cartan flux law from the original action that accommodates the nonlinear metric components missing from the existing W6 readback.
Construct a coupled W6/CH24 Bose-pair constraint and gauge/BRST physical domain preserved by the interaction and compatible with incoming/outgoing wave operators.
Resolve nonidentity of the original unit-coupling kinematic comparison without treating small-coupling family results as its proof.
After obtaining an action-owned physical scattering carrier, test physical on-shell transitions, continuum translation/momentum covariance and eligibility for the published celestial transform.

obstructions.summary: On the full twelve-real-control positive source-phase chart, the original nonlinear future-frame metric has no W6 fullbank preimage for sufficiently small nonzero pure-old controls; direct phase-to-W6 promotion therefore fails on that source family.

An inhabited original-action source-matched interior family retains a nonzero released middle-face boundary variation. Dirichlet source matching alone does not supply the free-boundary Euler equation or physical scattering dynamics.
